subject: Request: additional trial allocation for Undergrad NLP lab (Summer module)
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@northbridge.edu>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional trial allocation for Undergrad NLP lab (Summer module)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the students and I were very impressed by the latency and cost profile you showed for short-context models. We're running a condensed Summer module for our undergrad Computational Linguistics course (NLP 210) and would like to run a hands-on assignment that requires more inference quota than the standard free trial provides.

Course details (short):
- 120 undergrads (divided into 30 teams)
- two assignments: prompt engineering + small-scale fine-tune evaluation
- expected token volume: ~250k tokens over two weeks

Can Redwood provide a one-time trial top-up or a promotional allocation for academic use? We're a non-profit public university; if helpful, I can route a short letter on department letterhead. I've attached the syllabus excerpt and a budget note.

Ideal timeline: credit reflected by next Monday (20 July) so students can start. Happy to join a quick call to walk through usage patterns.

Best,
Prof. Elena Ortiz
Director, Computational Linguistics Lab
Northbridge University

Attachments: syllabus_nlp_2026.pdf, budget_request_v2.xlsx

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@northbridge.edu>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial allocation for Undergrad NLP lab (Summer module)

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the attachments, they help a lot. Looping in Neha (academic programs) and Marissa (partnerships) to review eligibility for an academic top-up.

Quick context for the team: Northbridge is running an undergrad course with ~120 students, expecting ~250k tokens total. They need the credit by next Monday if possible. Dept is public university / non-profit.

Elena, two quick clarifying Qs to help speed the approval:
1) Are student datasets synthetic or public-license? (we need to confirm no private PII ingestion for promo credits)
2) Do you plan to host any student data in a private deployment (VPC) or will all calls go to hosted API?

If it's all hosted and datasets are public/synthetic, we can usually approve a one-off promotional allocation (range depends on expected tokens). Neha & Marissa — any ballpark for a pilot top-up approval for a course like this?

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial allocation for Undergrad NLP lab (Summer module)

Thanks for the context, Dylan. I've reviewed the syllabus and the budget note. Good fit for our academic promotional program with a couple of guardrails.

Approval: one-time hosted API allocation of 300,000 tokens (promo credits) for Northbridge University — valid for 30 days from issuance.
Conditions:
- Dataset confirmation: public/synthetic only. Please have Prof. Ortiz reply confirming (Dylan copied).
- Attribution: use the short credit "Redwood Academic Pilot" in materials if you list partners.
- Usage monitoring: we'll enable short-term telemetry for the allocation so we can flag any anomalous usage.

Next steps for Dylan:
1) Draft the promo allocation in HubSpot (deal ND-9876) and mark as "Academic Pilot - Northbridge".
2) Request POC from Prof. Ortiz confirming datasets.
3) Issue promo code / allocation once Step 2 is received.

Dylan — I can authorize this on my end once we have the confirmation email. If you need the allocation sooner, we can provision a temporary hold and then finalize after confirmation.

Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@northbridge.edu>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial allocation for Undergrad NLP lab (Summer module)

Hi Marissa / Dylan — thank you! Confirming the datasets are public or synthetic: student assignments will use publicly available corpora (Wikipedia excerpts and OpenSubtitles samples) and a small synthetic prompt set we developed for evaluation. No private or PII data will be submitted to the API.

We're happy to use the Redwood Academic Pilot attribution in course materials. If you can provision the allocation (temporary hold or final code) by Monday that would be fantastic — I will let instructors know.

Best regards,
Elena
Prof. Elena Ortiz
Northbridge University
